name: Pac Ngoi
kicker: Tay stilt village on the Leng
summary: Sleep in a Tay stilt house on the Leng, where it meets the lake, so the boat is a morning. VOV says nearly 100 stilt roofs, some a century old. VnExpress says about 40 nhân khẩu. Those counts are not the same thing. The hamlet has few stores, so book the meal. The stay is a homestay, and the fee is check on arrival.
getThere: On the Leng, against the lake. Gate-to-house minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Stilt houses on the Leng, with the water in front and forest on the cliff

notice.title: Few stores in the hamlet
notice.body: VnExpress says the hamlet has few stores, so meals are booked with the house and water is carried in.

body: You sleep here. The locations index says thon Pac Ngoi, xa Ba Be, tinh Thai Nguyen. VOV still says xa Nam Mau, huyen Ba Be, Bac Kan. The hamlet head told VOV that about 80 percent of the old stilt houses are still standing, and that the hamlet is keeping them. VOV says nearly 100 stilt roofs, some a century old. VnExpress says about 40 nhân khẩu. Those two counts cannot be read as the same thing, so both stay. The district page counted nearly 60 homestay households in Nam Mau. A room that looks at the lake is one of the houses. Fuller facilities sit 1–2 km off the shore at the park gate. No hotel brand is a pick.

The day starts with the house meal and the walk to the landing. The house may offer a walk, weaving, an instrument, or fishing. After the evening meal, then singing and the đàn tính are the night if the house has called the hamlet troupe, with leaf-yeast wine. A closing hour was not printed. That hour is check on arrival.

figures.caption: Rice fields along the lake, with the cliff behind. The roofs in this frame are distant
figures.alt: Rice fields beside Ba Be Lake, with forested cliffs and a distant line of roofs

gettingThere: The village is the base, on the Leng against the lake. VnExpress describes a last-mile motorbike from the park gate into the village. Gate-to-house minutes were not printed. Cho Ra is the commune on the north edge, and the national tourism note’s 5 km is the distance to Puong, not a measured walk from the market to these houses.

legs.heading: From the park gate
legs.body: VnExpress describes a last-mile motorbike from the gate into the village, and says fuller facilities sit 1–2 km off the shore. Minutes and a fare are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By road. The kilometre counts disagree and are printed on the Ba Be page. They stop short of a door-to-door minute. The last minutes into the village are check on arrival.

admissionNote: The stay is a homestay, not a sight ticket. No room rate was adopted. The fee is check on arrival.
